# Signal Weekly — Oct 26–Nov 2, 2026

*Oct 26–Nov 2, 2026*

This week’s tech digest brings fresh twists in AI policy, gaming, space, and everyday gadgets—each story offering a new angle on how tech shapes our world.

## Tech news

- **[India floats AI plan under which ‘The model travels to the data, rather than the data travelling to the model’](https://www.theregister.com/public-sector/2026/11/02/india-floats-ai-plan-under-which-the-model-travels-to-the-data-rather-than-the-data-travelling-to-the-model/5306872)** (The Register) — India’s new AI plan keeps data in‑country, cutting reliance on foreign platforms.
- **[The HeroQuest board game is coming to Steam with a quest editor and multiplayer](https://www.pcgamer.com/games/board-games/the-heroquest-board-game-is-coming-to-steam-with-a-quest-editor-and-multiplayer/)** (PC Gamer) — HeroQuest lands on Steam, letting players craft and share custom adventures online.
- **[Linus Torvalds says Linux kernel is out of ‘stabilization phase’ and using ‘much healthier model’ for AI contributions](https://www.theregister.com/os-platforms/2026/11/01/linus-torvalds-says-linux-kernel-is-out-of-stabilization-phase-and-using-much-healthier-model-for-ai-contributions/5306852)** (The Register) — Linus Torvalds says Linux’s AI integration is now smoother, promising easier future development.
- **[OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/01/openai-might-rebrand-its-data-centers-as-ai-compute-campuses/)** (TechCrunch) — OpenAI may rename its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses,’ a move that could shift public perception.
- **[Game Off 2026: The theme is SHIFT](https://github.blog/open-source/gaming/game-off-2026-the-theme-is-shift/)** (GitHub Blog) — Game Off 2026 invites creators to explore the theme of SHIFT, fostering community‑driven game design.
- **[NASA hopes the commercial space industry can help save Hubble](https://www.theverge.com/science/1024239/nasa-commercial-space-save-hubble)** (The Verge) — NASA eyes commercial space solutions to keep Hubble operational, hinting at a new era of telescope maintenance.

## AI papers

- **[Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space for Unified Multimodal Models](http://arxiv.org/abs/2610.42149v1)** (Byungwoo Jeon, Yoonwoo Jeong et al.) — Latent Reasoning in Continuous Space could make multimodal AI more controllable and scalable for developers.

## Reviews

- **[How long is a new Apple TV actually supposed to last?](https://www.engadget.com/2300332/how-long-new-apple-tv-last-lifespan/)** (Engadget) — Engadget’s review warns Apple TV users to plan upgrades, as the new model’s lifespan may be shorter than expected.

---

Stay curious—next week we’ll dive into more ways tech is reshaping our lives.
